continuousFee(bytes32).details: The continuous fee is 0 until the market is created, then set to the default value.

enableLiquidationCursor(uint256).details: Enables a liquidationCursor for use at market creation. Liquidation cursors can only be enabled, never disabled. touchMarket checks the resulting maxLif for each market.liquidationCursor is required to be strictly below WAD so that maxLif's denominator (WAD - liquidationCursor * (WAD - lltv) / WAD) stays positive for every enabled lltv.

enableLltv(uint256).details: Enables a new LLTV tier. Tiers can only be enabled, never disabled.

isHealthy((uint256,address,address,(addr.details: This function should be called with the id corresponding to the market.This function does not call any oracle if debt is 0.Expects the id to correspond to the market's id.

liquidate((uint256,address,address,(addr.details: See LIQUIDATIONS section for more details.At least one of seizedAssets or repaidUnits should be equal to zero.Passing both 0 for seizedAssets and repaidUnits allows to realize bad debt with 0 token transferred.Liquidations with both 0 for seizedAssets and repaidUnits can be done with a collateral that is not activated.Returns the seized assets and the repaid units.

setConsumed(bytes32,uint128,address).details: Passing type(uint128).max cancels all offers in the group (and never reverts).

setMarketTickSpacing(bytes32,uint256).details: Refines the tick spacing of a market. Cannot increase (more ticks become accessible).

settlementFee(bytes32,uint256).details: Returns the settlement fee using piecewise linear interpolation between breakpoints.

settlementFeeCbps(bytes32).details: The settlement fee cbp values are 0 until the market is created, then set to the default value.

supplyCollateral((uint256,address,addres.details: This function checks authorization to prevent activated collateral poisoning.

take(((uint256,address,address,(address,.details: The taker might not get the price they expected if the settlement fee was just changed. A smart-contract can be used to perform atomic price checks.Taking buy offers with price < settlement fee will revert.In particular, if the settlement fee gets increased, it might implicitly cancel offers with very low price.All sellerAssets are reachable with the units input, and all buyerAssets are reachable only if buyerPrice <= WAD.The seller cannot be liquidated during the callbacks of a take.When onSell is called, the onBuy callback may have changed the state of Midnight.Returns buyerAssets and sellerAssets.

toMarket(bytes32).details: Reverts if the id is not a valid id of a touched market.Returns the market corresponding to the given id.

touchMarket((uint256,address,address,(ad.details: Returns the market id and creates the market if it doesn't exist yet.
